scope: conditional host sensitivity comparison, not an adopted product format or verified hardware persistence

record.header: magic[4], generation u32, payload length u16, version u16, crc32 u32
record.crc_input: first 12 header bytes followed by payload
record.key_payload: strictly ascending unique uint16 key, uint32 value pairs, 6 bytes per entry
record.footer: END1, generation u32, header checksum u32; padded to whole program units at bank end

write_policy.overwrite: erase every unit in the one bank, then program body; no old-value retention
write_policy.two-bank: erase every unit of inactive equal bank, program body, optionally footer last; read highest valid generation
write_policy.corrupt: do not erase without explicit replacement flag; equal valid generations refuse selection
write_policy.progress: one complete model erase/program operation per explicit step; volatile progress lost on abandon or cut

faults.boundaries: before update and after each complete operation
faults.additional: first half of operation bytes affected
faults.bank_locality: injected changes stay inside the selected operation; silicon fault domain is not established
faults.crc_limit: tested finite patterns only; arbitrary corruption and CRC collisions are not excluded

preconditions: exclusive serialized region access; RAW and formatted access do not share ownership
same conservative medium history retained across host scanner recreation
one program attempt per unit after completed erase
no MCU driver, ABI cost, stall time, endurance, upload or physical power-cut proof
